name: Turn listing photos into AI real estate walkthrough Reels and TikToks with Kling 3.0 and SocialRobot

parameters.content:
## Turn listing photos into an AI real estate walkthrough video

Upload 3-8 photos of a listing and get one vertical walkthrough video. Kling 3.0 animates a smooth camera move between each pair of neighbouring photos (photo 1 → 2, 2 → 3, ...), fal stitches the clips, and SocialRobot sends the video to your TikTok inbox as a draft. Instagram Reel, Facebook Reel and LinkedIn video are ready to switch on.

### How it works
1. **When Listing Submitted Trigger** takes the photos (named in walkthrough order), address, price, beds, baths, features and agent.
2. Photos are uploaded to fal storage and center-cropped to 9:16 (Kling takes the video shape from the start photo).
3. Optional: OpenAI looks at each photo pair and writes a camera move, then writes fair-housing-safe captions. Without OpenAI a safe default prompt and template captions are used.
4. One Kling 3.0 job per room pair (photo i = first frame, photo i+1 = last frame, 5 s, no audio). The workflow polls until all clips finish, fail or time out.
5. fal's FFmpeg merge joins the clips. Size and real MP4 duration are checked, then SocialRobot saves the TikTok draft.
6. Any failure stops with one readable message.

### Setup steps
- [ ] SocialRobot community node `@socialrobot-io/n8n-nodes-socialrobot` 3.1.1+ (works on n8n Cloud too) and your SocialRobot API key
- [ ] Connect TikTok in SocialRobot and pick the account in **Create TikTok Draft Walkthrough**
- [ ] fal API key as a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Key YOUR_FAL_KEY`. Select it in every fal HTTP node
- [ ] OpenAI credential on **OpenAI Luna Model**, or set `use_openai` to false
- [ ] Check **Set Walkthrough Configurations**

Runs on n8n Cloud and self-hosted: no ffmpeg or Execute Command needed.

### Customization
- `video_model`: Kling 3.0 Standard by default. Pro: `fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video` and `price_per_second_usd` 0.112.
- `clip_seconds` (3-15), `generate_audio`, prompts, guardrails, hashtags, AI label line and footer.
- Enable the optional posts (disabled by default). SocialRobot does not publish to YouTube.

### Cost per run (fal list prices, 19 Oct 2026)
Kling 3.0 Standard, no audio: $0.084/s, so $0.42 per 5 s clip. 6 photos = 5 clips = **$2.10**; 8 photos = **$2.94**. With audio $0.126/s ($3.15 for 5 clips). Pro: $0.112/s ($2.80 for 5 clips). fal lists crop and merge at $0. OpenAI adds a few cents.

## 1. Collect the listing
**When Listing Submitted Trigger** is the form. **Set Walkthrough Configurations** holds every value you'd want to change, including the model id. **If Sufficient Photos Present** needs 3-8 photos.

## 2. Order and measure photos
**Prepare Photos for Walkthrough** sorts by file name (01-entry.jpg, 02-living.jpg ...). **Plan Vertical Crop for Photos** reads each size and plans a centered 9:16 crop.

## 3. Prepare fal uploads
**Post to fal for Upload URL** asks fal storage for one upload URL per photo, and **Prepare Photos for Upload** puts each photo next to its URL.

## 4. Store and crop photos
**Put Photo to fal Storage** uploads each photo, and **Post Crop Request to fal** makes the 9:16 frames.

## 5. Pair the rooms
**Pair Photos into Clips** checks every photo made it and pairs neighbours. **Route by Walkthrough Plan** sends photo problems to the error lane, and picks OpenAI or the default prompt from `use_openai`.

## 6. Camera moves (optional OpenAI)
**Generate Camera Move Prompts** sees both photos of each pair and describes one camera move using only what is visible. **Aggregate Room Notes** falls back to the default prompt for any pair OpenAI missed.

## 7. Captions
**Generate Listing Captions** writes TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn captions under fair housing rules. With `use_openai` off, template captions are used.

## 8. Submit Kling jobs
**Prepare Clip Requests for Kling** makes one fal request per room pair (first frame, last frame, prompt + guardrails, 5 s) and adds the AI label to every caption. **Post Clip Jobs to Kling** queues them.

## 9. Confirm queued jobs
**Check Clip Jobs Queued** makes sure every clip has a fal request id. If one failed, the others are canceled.

## 10. Poll clip progress
Checks every 20 s. fal runs one Kling job at a time per account by default, so clips finish one after another. **Evaluate Clip Completion** marks the batch done, failed or timed out (60 min); failures and timeouts cancel unfinished jobs.

## 11. Fetch finished clips
**Get Clip Results from fal** gets each clip and **Compile Clip URLs** keeps them in walkthrough order.

## 12. Merge on fal
**Post to fal for Clip Merge** joins the clips with fal-ai/ffmpeg-api/merge-videos, so nothing runs on your server.

## 13. Check the video
**Check Video Size and Duration** reads the real MP4 duration before anything goes to SocialRobot.

## 14. Save the TikTok draft
**Create TikTok Draft Walkthrough** uses Post Mode *Send to Inbox (Draft)*. Nothing is public until you post it in the TikTok app.

## Optional posts (disabled)
Connected and **disabled by default**. Enable, pick an account and they publish when the run finishes.
- **Submit Instagram Reel**: Reel with the AI label on
- **Publish Facebook Reel**
- **Post LinkedIn Video via SocialRobot**: LinkedIn video needs video metadata the node doesn't expose yet, so this calls the SocialRobot API. Add a Header Auth credential (`x-api-key`) and set `linkedin_account_id`.

## Handle errors
Wrong photo count, upload or crop problems, rejected or failed Kling jobs, timeouts, merge or download errors, files that fail the checks and SocialRobot errors end here with one readable message. Add an error workflow in the settings for alerts.

## Switching to Kling 4.0 later
The model id lives in one place: `video_model` in **Set Walkthrough Configurations**. When a Kling 4.0 image-to-video endpoint with published per-second pricing is live on fal, change that value and `price_per_second_usd`. **Prepare Clip Requests for Kling** sends Kling 3.0 extras (audio, negative prompt, cfg) only to v3 endpoints, and sends duration as the string Kling 3.0 expects or the number the Kling 4.0 schema expects. Check the new endpoint's input fields on fal before switching.

## AI label and fair housing
- Kling creates new frames between real photos. Every caption ends with `ai_label_line`, and **Submit Instagram Reel** has **AI-Generated Content** on.
- The node doesn't send TikTok's AI label for inbox drafts: turn on 'AI-generated content' in TikTok before posting.
- Prompts forbid adding furniture, rooms, views or features, but always watch the video against the real photos before posting. Don't use it as your MLS virtual tour unless your MLS allows AI media.
- Captions describe the property, never who should live there. Have a person review them.

parameters.formDescription: Upload 3-8 photos of one listing, named in walkthrough order (01-entry.jpg, 02-living.jpg, 03-kitchen.jpg ...). Each pair of neighbouring photos becomes a 5-second AI camera move. The finished vertical video goes to your TikTok inbox as a draft.

values.placeholder: One per line. Only true, checkable facts about the property.
Optional public link to the full listing

values.formSubmittedText: Thanks! Your walkthrough is rendering. It usually lands in your TikTok inbox within 10-30 minutes.

assignments.name: negative_prompt
assignments.value: blur, distortion, warped walls, bent lines, flicker, people, pets, added furniture, extra rooms, text, watermark, logo, low quality

assignments.name: default_camera_prompt
assignments.value: Slow, steady, eye-level gimbal walkthrough that glides smoothly from the first view to the second, like an agent walking a buyer through the home. Realistic natural light, gentle motion.

assignments.name: prompt_guardrails
assignments.value: Keep every wall, window, floor, fixture and piece of furniture exactly as photographed. Do not add, remove or restyle furniture, decor, rooms, views or features. No people, pets, text, logos or watermarks.

assignments.name: caption_tone
assignments.value: Warm, clear and factual. No hype.

assignments.name: ai_label_line
assignments.value: AI-generated walkthrough made from real listing photos, for illustration only. See the listing for exact details.

parameters.text:
=You direct an AI image-to-video model (Kling 3.0) that animates one step of a real estate walkthrough between two real listing photos.
Image 1 is the START frame ({{ $json.start_photo }}). Image 2 is the END frame ({{ $json.end_photo }}).
This is clip {{ $json.pair_number }} of {{ $json.pair_count }}, {{ $('Set Walkthrough Configurations').first().json.clip_seconds }} seconds, vertical 9:16.
Listing context (do not add anything that is not visible in the two photos): {{ $('When Listing Submitted Trigger').first().json['Property Address'] }}. Features: {{ ($('When Listing Submitted Trigger').first().json['Key Features'] || 'none given').replace(/\n/g, '; ') }}

Return:
- start_room: a short name for the room or area in image 1 (for example 'living room', 'kitchen', 'front exterior'), based only on what you see.
- end_room: the same for image 2.
- camera_prompt: one paragraph in English, under 600 characters, describing a single smooth, steady, eye-level gimbal move that starts exactly on image 1 and ends exactly on image 2 (for example a slow walk forward through a doorway, a gentle pan, or a slow turn). Mention only things visible in the photos.

Rules for camera_prompt: keep every wall, window, floor, ceiling, fixture, finish and piece of furniture exactly as photographed. Do not add, remove, move or restyle furniture, decor, appliances, rooms, doors, windows, views, landscaping, pools or any other feature. No people, pets, text, logos or watermarks. No change of time of day, weather or season. Realistic natural lighting, no fast moves, no fisheye, no drone shot unless both photos are aerial exteriors. If the two spaces do not look connected, use a slow forward move with a soft natural transition instead of inventing a hallway or a new room.
